rows.grounds: genitive plural of a three-member compound; no sandhi fusion marker present

items.question: What is the width of the kūṭa koṣṭha and nīḍa structures?
premises: width of kūṭa-koṣṭha-nīḍa is one part
eva and hi emphasize the measure
items.inference: The width of those three structures equals one part.
uncertainties: Exact architectural referents of kūṭa, koṣṭha, and nīḍa are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: The width of the kūṭa, koṣṭha, and nīḍa is indeed one part.
